readOnlyVerification.visibleDataSql: WITH tables AS (SELECT n.nspname,c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user AND has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT')), measured AS (SELECT nspname,relname,query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*)::text AS row_count, encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(h,E''\\n'' ORDER BY h),''''),''UTF8'')),''hex'') AS data_hash FROM (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,''UTF8'')),''hex'') AS h FROM %I.%I t) rows',nspname,relname),true,false,'') AS x FROM tables) SELECT nspname AS schema,relname AS table_name,(xpath('/table/row/row_count/text()',x))[1]::text AS row_count,(xpath('/table/row/data_hash/text()',x))[1]::text AS sha256 FROM measured ORDER BY 1,2
catalogSql: SELECT 'tables' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relpersistence,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,c.relacl::text FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','p','S')) x

SELECT 'columns' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expr,a.attacl::text FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','p','S')) x

SELECT 'constraints' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,k.conname,k.contype,k.convalidated,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true) AS definition FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%') x

SELECT 'indexes' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT schemaname,tablename,indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')) x

SELECT 'policies' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT schemaname,tablename,policyname,permissive,roles,cmd,qual,with_check FROM pg_policies) x

SELECT 'functions' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS args,p.prokind,p.prosecdef,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.proconfig,p.proacl::text,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,p.prosrc,p.probin,pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS result FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')) x

SELECT 'triggers' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) AS definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')) x

SELECT 'namespaces' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT nspname,pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) AS owner,nspacl::text FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%') x

SELECT 'roles' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolconnlimit,rolvaliduntil,rolconfig FROM pg_roles) x

SELECT 'memberships' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT pg_get_userbyid(roleid) AS role_name,pg_get_userbyid(member) AS member_name,pg_get_userbyid(grantor) AS grantor_name,admin_option,inherit_option,set_option FROM pg_auth_members) x

SELECT 'acls' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole) AS owner,coalesce(n.nspname,'') AS schema,d.defaclobjtype,d.defaclacl::text FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace) x

SELECT 'sequences' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT schemaname,sequencename,sequenceowner,data_type,start_value,min_value,max_value,increment_by,cycle,cache_size FROM pg_sequences) x

SELECT 'extensions' AS kind,count(*)::int AS objects,encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(x)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY to_jsonb(x)::text),''),'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256 FROM (SELECT extname,extversion,pg_get_userbyid(extowner) AS owner,extnamespace::regnamespace::text AS schema FROM pg_extension) x

# Identity Runtime — reusable core and PORR-first deployment decision

22 October 2026. Owner: Architecture Platform. Profile: ARCHITECTURE. Environment: development. Repository authority: profitia/SG-dev, main.

## Decision and its source

The owner-established business/architecture requirement is **Single Identity Core / Configurable Client Deployments**. Its source is sections 4 and 12 of the owner-supplied task “TASK B2-D — Source Promotion & Controlled Development First Deployment”, task `ARCHITECTURE-IDENTITY-B2-D-FIRST-RELEASE-20261022`, in host conversation `01a15aed-8d94-7fe0-9cff-c54f72b5f8a8`. This is a reference to the actual supplied decision, not a GitHub approval or an invented approval identifier.

The requirement is accepted as business/architecture input. This separate governance-only record is proposed for source review; it does not activate routing, an application, infrastructure or authentication. It must not be inserted into the already reviewed corrective PR #599.

## One reusable identity core

Maintain one canonical Identity Runtime, authentication/session engine and deterministic Conversational Form Engine. Reuse centrally maintained security and session contracts and the shared visual components derived from [the MagicPath design](https://www.magicpath.ai/files/463393726950178816). Clerk retains authentication authority; Profitia retains internal identities, organisations, memberships and product permissions through the existing Access Store.

Future reviewed configuration may select branding, approved registration/login steps and additional validated client fields. Optional dedicated client deployments may differ in URL, configuration and release lifecycle while using the same canonical source. They must not create permanent source forks, independent identity authority, duplicate B1 databases or separate authentication engines.

## First rollout: PORR, with multiple organisations

`FIRST_DEPLOYMENT_CLIENT = PORR`. Initially one Identity Portal deployment serves the PORR implementation. Multiple Organisation IDs must be supportable within that deployment. Expected later organisational contexts are PORR customer users and Profitia internal testers, kept separate by canonical membership and product permissions.

One client deployment is not one Organisation ID. One identity account is not one organisation membership. An authenticated user is not automatically an authorised product user. A user may later hold several explicitly authorised memberships; session establishment must grant none automatically. A form field, URL or branding choice cannot select trusted organisation authority.

Reuse before duplication: adding an organisation does not require cloning Render infrastructure or Clerk instances. No permanent requirement to create one service per organisation is established. Optional client deployments and organisation membership remain separate architectural concepts.

## Bounded first-release proposal and approval gate

B1 remains INSTALLED_ACCEPTED; B2 is merged at `4115d539501bfd73c4467129caacbadd6c94b8a4`. The completed preparation is recorded in [PHR d67e34a](https://github.com/profitia/project-history-repository/commit/d67e34abd4739c5c9fda41994259d5e29c7b194b). Its immutable records are retained.

[Corrective PR #599](https://github.com/profitia/SG-dev/pull/599), exact candidate `c8936471e2e295dde0a470361ab309fcd12c37f3`, remains a separate source approval. Its strict deployment-owned public origin corrects the demonstrated health-only Host mismatch without weakening Host validation or changing session contracts. The [candidate first-release runbook](https://github.com/profitia/SG-dev/blob/c8936471e2e295dde0a470361ab309fcd12c37f3/Canon/runbooks/identity-runtime-development-first-release-v1.md) defines exact build/start/configuration and stop controls.

Only HEALTH_ONLY / `IDENTITY_RUNTIME_ENABLED=false` is proposed. The logical PORR-first decision does not imply productive PORR access or a PORR-branded UI.

The task expressly withholds merge, infrastructure and spending permission. One separate combined owner GO must cover the exact PR candidate; one service and first deployment; Free compute plus at most USD 25 additional Performance pipeline spend, one build attempt and a 20-minute build limit; and the exact health-only configuration, restart and stop/cancel/suspend plan. Before that GO: OWNER_APPROVAL=PENDING, FIRST_DEPLOY_EXECUTED=NO. Source promotion SHA, service hostname/ID and deploy/artifact identifiers remain unknown until verified execution. Historical CI/local readiness is not live provider acceptance.

No UI, form engine, schema extension, deployment manager, no-code builder, client cloning, additional instance, per-organisation Clerk instance, organisation onboarding, automatic assignment or consumer integration is implemented here. No PORR/Profitia organisation record, user, membership or grant is created. Product source, database schema/data, Clerk configuration, credentials and deployments remain unchanged.
